CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Destroy trees without planting
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Waste food daily

2. Which response best shows understanding of Places of? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Places of.
   B. Apply the teaching of Places of with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Places of has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Places of to insult classmates of other faiths.

3. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

4. Which response best shows understanding of Greatest? (1 mark)
   A. Use Greatest to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Greatest with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Greatest.
   D. Say Greatest has no place in daily life.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Christian? (1 mark)
   A. Say Christian has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian.
   C. Apply the teaching of Christian with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Christian to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Spreading rumours
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Cheating in exams

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible BIBLE? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible BIBLE to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible BIBLE.
   C. Say The Bible BIBLE has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The Bible BIBLE with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Church Service WORSHIP? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Church Service WORSHIP.
   B. Use Church Service WORSHIP to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Church Service WORSHIP with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Church Service WORSHIP has no place in daily life.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Communicating to? (1 mark)
   A. Use Communicating to to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Communicating to.
   C. Say Communicating to has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Communicating to with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Name of God? (1 mark)
   A. Say Name of God has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Name of God to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Name of God.
   D. Apply the teaching of Name of God with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Creation: Parts of CREATION? (1 mark)

   B. Use Creation: Parts of CREATION to insult classmates of other faiths.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Creation: Parts of CREATION.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS.
   D. Say Christian RELIGIOUS FESTIVALS AND RITUALS has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Places of and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
